focus.purpose: Bound and name the direct F2 continuation of the player airborne action AnimationVM stream.

decoded: F4 compares player action field 0xF0C8 against zero and branches to 0x0012269A
Presents frame 0x0C56 and writes player animation field 0xF0DA to 1
Writes player field 0xF11F to 1 and presents the 0x0C5A/0x0C5E response
EA returns to the existing player response path at 0x0012217A
evidence: Exact F2 branch target from PLAYER_ANIM_ACTION_AIRBORNE_RESPONSE
Exact F5 template pointer and FB callback parameter
conclusion: The former 0x00122672-0x001226B1 layout fragment is a direct airborne-action continuation, not opaque data. It is now canonically named and range-bounded while the owning player action root remains separately owned.
